infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: We use the microphone only when you tap the voice-capture button, to turn your spoken notes into tasks. Recognition runs on-device whenever possible.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: We use speech recognition to turn your voice notes into tasks. It runs on-device when your device supports it.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Attach photos to your tasks — a snap of a whiteboard, receipt, or sketch.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pick an existing photo to attach to a task.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Personal Manager to access the microphone for voice capture.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow Personal Manager to recognize speech on-device.

plugins.cameraPermission: Attach photos to your tasks — a snap of a whiteboard, receipt, or sketch.
plugins.photosPermission: Pick an existing photo to attach to a task.
